reason: The finding's headline, and the sentence it gives for the user, contradict its own MC output (scratchpad r39/mc39_cprior.txt, recounted). The claim is that cap-6 partners are 'below both cap-4 partners in 12/12 runs' and that 'при любом априоре ... cap 4 выше в 12 из 12'. That holds only on BRONZE: exp79a is below #37 and exp75 12/12, and exp85a is below #37 12/12 and below exp75 11/12 (1/12 it is above: C +0.0004 sd 0.0012 seed 39, .832 vs .831). On SILVER the JT neighbour exp85a is ABOVE #37 in 12/12 runs, including under the lab prior C -0.0006 (.485/.491 vs .474/.490). exp79a is above #37 in 4/12 (plus 1 tie), and exp85a is above exp75 in 2/12. So the answer 'cap-4 partners are higher in 12 of 12 runs under any prior' is false for #37, the card's FIRST-choice partner (P3). The '12/12' is also 6 configurations x 2 seeds (seed spread <= 0.006), not 12 independent checks. The C prior of -0.0006 comes from the in-sample exp60 lab on train clips, which the project already knows over-trusts in-sample effects (edge-filter +0.016 lab / 0 LB). mc26 itself is judgmental ('ranks only', I-092). The sub-claims that do hold: P2 >= P3 on silver 12/12; bronze P3 ahead 5/12 by <= 0.011; {#37,#38} ticked at ~.49/.11. The practical outcome (no card change, cap-4 partner, keep pushing 'tick now') survives. On this MC, P2 {exp87a, exp75} is weakly ahead of P3 (silver 12/12, Eval 10/12, bronze 7/12). But the finding as written would give the user a factually wrong line, so I refute it as stated.
fix: Replace the user-facing line with one the MC supports: 'По бронзе партнёры с cap 4 выше партнёров с cap 6 почти во всех прогонах (#37 — 12/12, exp75 — 11/12). По серебру это неверно: exp85a (ближайший сосед) выше #37 во всех 12 прогонах, но exp75 выше exp85a в 10/12. Лучший партнёр по модели — exp75 (П2): серебро 12/12, ожидание 10/12, бронза почти вровень с П3. Карточку не меняем, П3 и П2 почти равны.' Restate the headline the same way: 'bronze only; on silver exp75 dominates'. Label the result as 6 configurations x 2 seeds. Mark C -0.0006 as an in-sample lab prior (weak). No build, dummy, slot or rule change.
realistic_gain: 0 on LB or private score; it only prevents a wrong statement to the user. If anything it nudges the tie towards P2 {exp87a, exp75}, worth about +0.02-0.07 in modelled P(silver) and ~0 in P(bronze), judgmental model on one embryo.
